# imaginarybit

> Łukasz Huńczak: software architect and engineer for real-time media
> systems: C++, GStreamer, FFmpeg, WebRTC and Qt.

## Projects

- [pipeline-monitor](https://imaginarybit.com/pipeline-monitor/): a GStreamer
  tracer that shows a running pipeline live in the browser; demo recordings
  open without installing. More: [its llms.txt](https://imaginarybit.com/pipeline-monitor/llms.txt)
- [pipeline-monitor source and releases](https://github.com/imgbit/pipeline-monitor)
  (LGPL-2.1-or-later; commercial license and support available)
